simple.meaning: a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כּוֹס (H3563) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

definitions.full: H3563. kowc I. כּוֺס noun feminine Lam 4:21 cup (√ unknown; perhaps kindred with כִּיס , q. v.; Late Hebrew id. ; Phoenician כסת ; Aramaic כָּס , ; Arabic is Aramaic loan-word according to Frä 171 , but see DHM VOJ i. 27 ) — ׳כ absolute Gen 40:11 +; כּ֯יֹס Prov 23:31 ; construct Gen 40:11 +; suffix כּוֺסִי Psa 16:5 ; 23:5 etc.; plural absolute כֹּסוֺת Jer 35:5 ; — cup 2Sam 12:3 ; for wine Gen 40:11 (3 t. in verse); 40:13 , 21 (all E), Prov 23:31 ; Jer 35:5 ; שְׂפַתאכּוֺס 1Kin 7:26 ; 2Chr 4:5 ; ׳כ תַּנְחוּמִים Jer 16:7 the cup offered to mourners; figurative (wine-) cup of judgement of ׳י , from which the nations, or Israel, must drink 49:12 ; Lam 4:21 ; Psa 75:9 ; ׳כ חֲמָתוֺ Isa 51:17 , 22 ; הַחֵמָה ׳כ הַיַּיִן Jer 25:15 , compare 25:17 ; 25:28 ; ׳כ הַתַּרְעֵלָה Isa 51:17 , 22 ; וּשְׁמָמָה שַׁמָּה ׳כ Ezek 23:33 , compare 23:31 ; 23:32 ; 23:33 ; ׳כ י ׳יְמִין Hab 2:16 ; by bold metaphor Babylon is such a cup י ׳בְּיַד ׳כ זָהָב Jer 51:7 ; so of wicked persons, fire, brimstone, and burning wind are מְנָתאכּוֺסָם Psa 11:6 the portion of their cup ; ׳כ in good sense, cup of blessing 23:5 (overflowing); ׳י וְכוֺסִי חֶלְקִי מְנָת 16:5 ; ׳כ יְשׁוּעוֺת 116:13 . II. כּוֺס noun [masculine] a kind of owl (according to Vrss.; see Kn-Di Lev 11:17 ; word perhaps onomatopoetic) — unclean bird 11:17 ; Deut 14:16 , dwelling in ruins ׳כִ חֳרָבוֺת Psa 102:7 .
